Pipeline Architecture

This page provides the authoritative structural index of the SDuX reactive pipeline. It enumerates every execution layer and pipeline stage in their deterministic order.

Each stage listed below links to its dedicated documentation page. This document does not duplicate stage-level specifications. Instead, it serves as the canonical architectural map of pipeline responsibility boundaries and execution flow.

Use this page when designing FeatureCell behavior stacks, validating execution order, or navigating between pipeline stages.

Pipeline Stage Matrix
Policy Layer
Stage Primary Responsibility Documentation
Policy (Controllers) Governs execution authority for pipeline attempts. Evaluates and enforces whether an update is allowed, denied, or aborted before pipeline computation begins. View
Pre-Processing Layer
Stage Primary Responsibility Documentation
Interceptors Admission control and conditional gating before pipeline execution begins. View
Pre-Cache Optional pre-admission caching and update coordination. RoadMap
Processing Layer
Stage Primary Responsibility Documentation
Resolve Normalizes incoming input types into a resolved candidate value. View
Merge Combines the current committed state with the resolved candidate value. View
Stepwise Resolve Optional staged resolution for incremental candidate production. View
Operators Refines or suppresses the merged candidate before filtering. View
Filters Refines or suppresses candidate values prior to reduction. View
Stepwise Filter Optional incremental filtering of staged candidates. View
Before Tap* Observational callbacks executed prior to reduction. View
Reducers Computes the finalized candidate state from the processed value. View
Stepwise Reducer Optional incremental reduction of staged values. View
After Tap* Observational callbacks executed after reduction. View
Output Layer
Stage Primary Responsibility Documentation
Encryption Transforms outbound snapshots prior to persistence. View
Persist Stores committed state snapshots externally. View
Post-Processing Layer
Stage Primary Responsibility Documentation
State Cache Coordinates cache synchronization after persistence. View
Offline Mode Handles external coordination for offline scenarios. RoadMap
State Emission Commits and exposes finalized state snapshots. View
Error Layer
Stage Primary Responsibility Documentation
Core Error Normalizes and captures pipeline errors. View
Error Transform Transforms or augments errors prior to exposure. View
Error Emitters Emits normalized errors to registered observers. View
